newsitem.title: PERU: Lima share prices end firm on miners' bull run.
newsitem.headline: Lima share prices end firm on miners' bull run.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed firm Monday as the mining sector's ongoing bull run outweighed falls in other leading stocks, brokers said.
Players expected the same trend Tuesday, they added.

Monday, the .IGRA rose 0.88 percent to 2,063.5 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL climbed 0.20 percent to 2,985.6 points, according to preliminary figures given at the market's close at 1.30 p.m. local time (1830 GMT).

In a total of 2,347 trades, volume was a modest 26.7 million soles ($10.0 million), brokers said. With the return of foreign investors following Monday's national holiday in the United States, trade was likely to swell Tuesday, they added.

As the New York Stock Exchange was closed Monday, the Lima bolsa lacked a basic barometer to dictate its trend, making many local investors cautious, Percy Romero of local brokerage Fortuna said. Benchmark Telefonica del Peru edged down Monday 0.62 percent, closing at 6.39 soles on meager volume of 256,000 shares.
Polymetallic miner Milpo jumped 10.02 percent to 35.81 soles on volume of 77,000 shares. Atacocha also rose 2.02 percent to 2.53 soles on strong volume of 1.2 milion shares.
